items.quote: Global Leadership Advancing Student Success (GLASS) is a program designed to advance international student professional development in preparation for U.S. and global work cultures, leadership, and success. Through interactive sessions, networking opportunities, and hands-on projects, ISSO GLASS empowers students to become global leaders ready to succeed in an interconnected world.
Explore the ISSO GLASS workshops and map out your personalized professional development journey.Get started with our Canvas course.
